PLYR ACCESS Day

How the day runs

01 · Register

Our team signs every player up for PLYRCARD, in person. Name, grad year, position, team, academics, contacts and schedule.

02 · Photos

MediaPLYR takes two professional shots: a headshot for the PLYRSITE and a player pose for their PLYRCARD.

03 · PLYR Lab

A combine that sets their baseline: height, weight, laser-timed speed and RSI on force plates.

Then · Webinar

Players attend the webinar, and their PLYRSITE goes live.

~1 HRper team
2 DAYSone for boys, one for girls

PLYR Lab

See where you stand. See where to work.

Ratings shown in plain language, color-coded: green is top of the group, yellow is the middle, red is the focus area. Sample ratings shown.

What we need

What we need from NVA
